snippet.title: A Monster's Expedition - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
An adorable and relaxing open world puzzle adventure for monsters who love to learn about humans!

Play it on:

🎒PlayStation 5: https://store.playstation.com/en-gb/concept/10003653/

https://www.monsterexpedition.com/
